name: Encyclopaedia Britannica Syndication API
tagline: Licensed encyclopedia articles and media via Britannica's syndication API
description: Official Encyclopaedia Britannica Syndication API for licensed encyclopedia content: article lists (JSON), full article bodies (XML), and media (images, audio, video). Products include full Britannica, Concise, Intermediate, Elementary/Primary, Portuguese editions, and thematic subsets (science, people, places, etc.). Free for non-commercial apps under 1,000 queries/day (two keys); commercial use requires a Britannica license. Note: api.britannica.com does not resolve; this is not the library product Britannica Academic (academic.eb.com).

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header. Self-serve register at encyclopediaapi.com (email verification); two keys on signup, more by contact. Key is product-scoped (articleTypeId/thematic category chosen at registration).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Non-commercial only: 1,000 queries/day per API key; max two reference APIs. Cached content may be shown for 30 days only.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial use (ads or paid product) or over 1,000 queries/day requires a licensing fee; contact Britannica for case-by-case terms.

rate_limits: 1,000 queries per API key per day; exceeding call_limit returns 401 (per OpenAPI). No finer per-second limit published.
use_cases: list encyclopedia articles for a product level (e.g. intermediate articleTypeId=31)
fetch full article XML by articleId for a learning app
list articles updated since a date for content sync
pull a thematic subset (science, animals, people) via categoryId
resolve media URLs from article XML (cdn.britannica.com images/audio)
